integrity: Full proof supplied; finite exhaustive checks corroborate, not certify, all orders. Priority remains subject to inspection of full Row cutvertex work and differently indexed enumerations. No invented authorship or independent validation.
limitations: One pendant leaf at each vertex of a simple cycle; integer n >= 3; ordinary zero forcing only. No extension to other coronas or forcing rules is proved. Earliest first-public date pertains to foundational zero forcing, not to a claimed prior sunlet polynomial.
title: Exact zero-forcing polynomial of sunlet graphs via alternating-path obstruction
